notes.title: Radiation Rewards: New Steam Items Unlocked!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, survivors!

The radiation is spreading... but this time, it brings something exciting! We’ve just released brand-new Steam community items! 

Collect radioactive trading cards, light up your profile with glowing backgrounds, and unlock emoticons and avatar frames inspired by the post-apocalyptic world.

Jump into the game, embrace the fallout, and start earning these rewards. Thank you for being part of our resilient community!

Best regards,
OneHand Games Team[/h3]

notes.title: Wasteland awaits – S.E.X. Z.O.N.E. is out!
notes.notes:
[h3]The wait is finally over – S.E.X. Z.O.N.E. is now released! 

Welcome to the lands near Chernobyl, but watch your steps - danger might lurk at any corner. As the protector of a bunker full of hotties, it’s your mission to scavenge surroundings for vital resources, uncover rare artifacts, and build relationships that lead to a lot of, in such an environment, much-needed fun and relaxation.

Explore a place filled with mutants, anomalies, and radiation - every step and choice you make shapes your survival and your relationships. Don't miss on your ultimate goal of claiming the rarest artifact hidden deep within - it makes girls go crazy about you. With hot adult content, intense ventures and immersive gameplay, the game promises an adventure like no other - grab your key and start the journey now!

notes.title: Hold Your Geiger Counters – S.E.X. Z.O.N.E. is Almost Here!
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re putting the finishing touches on S.E.X. Z.O.N.E., and while we need a little more time to make it perfect, we’re thrilled to announce the game will officially launch this Saturday!

Thank you for your patience as we polish every detail, from the intense exploration and character-driven narrative to the hot adult scenes that await for you in the Zone. This extra time allows us to ensure a smoother experience, so your journey through the wasteland is as thrilling and rewarding as possible. 

Prepare to protect your bunker, venture into dangerous lands, and build unforgettable relationships with the girls who depend on you. Your ultimate adventure in the Zone is just around the corner!

[u]Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and get ready to dive into the S.E.X. Z.O.N.E. this Saturday.[/u] 

Trust us, the wait will be worth it! 💦☢️[/h3]
